finding: src/anomaly/semantics.py:52 The shared durable-error sanitizer misses standard compound credential assignments such as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY.
rationale: The blocker survives because the gated sanitizer's leading word boundary cannot start at SECRET or API after an underscore, no other sanitizer pattern covers these compound assignment names, and real P5/P6 invoker exceptions are caught and copied through safe_error into every named durable failure surface without an upstream guard.
